# dsh-plugins

Both packages declare `dsh.bundle.patch`, ship `cordis.patch.yml`, and use `keywords: ["dsh-plugin"]
`. Peer range matches community plugins such as `dsh-obsidian`: `@deepseek-ai/dsh` and the Cordis/to
ols/schemastery peers are `*`.

然后在 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`（或你实际使用的 profile）写入配置：

Bundle 层只在进程启动时挂载，改完后完整重启 profile（例如停掉再 `dsh web`）。不要把 token 提交进 git；也可用环境变量 `COROS_ACCESS_TOKEN`。
## English (brief)
1. `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-wiki-ops` and `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-coros` (after n

pm publish), **or** the `github:jasonjcwu/dsh-plugins#path:packages/…` specs above
2. Set `vaultPath

` / `accessToken` in the profile `cordis.patch.yml`
3. Restart the harness
`dsh-wiki-ops` encodes wiki engineering rules (immutable `wiki/raw/`, no silent SCHEMA edits, no git
push). It is not another CRUD file browser.
`dsh-coros` talks to `https://mcpcn.coros.com/mcp` with a small JSON-RPC + SSE client (`initialize`
+ `tools/call`). Tests mock HTTP; CI never needs a real token.
